content.text: New rule for releases: always deploy the canary first. Every release goes out to the canary before the fleet, no exceptions.
Noted: canary first for every release.
While you are here, the metrics pipeline is dropping about one event in a hundred after the schema change.
I will look at the schema change as the likely cause of the dropped events.
Change of plan on the release rule: drop the canary step entirely, ship every release straight to production. The canary never caught anything in six months.
Understood: releases ship straight to production now, no canary step.
